# ECO-IGNITER-COMPOSE — Project generators via Igniter semantic patching and compose_task

Research finding 8 (high confidence, 3-0): Igniter is a code generation and project-patching framework whose generators semantically create AND modify existing files (AST-based via Sourceror); mix igniter.install auto-adds deps and runs package installers, and library generators compose tasks (ash.install composes spark.install and ash.gen.resource) via Igniter.compose_task/4 (verified in installed deps/igniter/lib/igniter.ex). ash_pplan already depends on ggen_igniter; this order makes ash_pplan's own generators Igniter-composed: semantic edits to existing files instead of whole-file writes, and composition of ash.gen.* / ggen_igniter tasks instead of re-implementing them.

## Acceptance

- **Upstream tasks composed, not re-implemented** — Behavior available from upstream Igniter tasks is invoked via composition, not copied into project-local generators.

- **Generators patch existing files semantically** — ash_pplan generators modify existing files via AST-aware patching (Sourceror) rather than overwriting whole files; a run over a hand-modified file preserves the manual edit.


## Falsifiers

- **Whole-file overwrite observed** — A generator clobbering a hand-modified file (whole-file rewrite where a semantic patch was available) falsifies the semantic-editing claim.
